name: Camping Wertacher Hof
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

Camping Wertacher Hof is located in Oy-Mittelberg in the Tiroler Allgäu. The site is surrounded by Wald and Bergen. The facility offers Stellplätze and Mietunterkünfte. A Restaurant with regional dishes is available. The surrounding area features Wanderwege and Langlauf-Loipen. The campsite is suitable for Naturliebhaber and Familien.
